tokens.name: school-green
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo's ring and tower. Brand fills: the logo, the outer line of the A4 page border, pupil tile 1, decorative blocks. Not a text colour (2.6:1 on surface); text on it is `on-fill`.

tokens.name: school-gold
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo's two figures. The inner line of the A4 page border, pupil tile 2, thin highlights. Never text on light grounds (1.9:1); `on-fill` reads on it at 8.6:1.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: The school's structural green, darkened from `school-green` so text can sit on it. App bar, navigation rail, section headers. Text on it: `on-green-deep`.

tokens.name: on-green-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `green-deep` (8.9:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green used as text or a 2px mark: selected tab label, links, the selected outline of a map cell. 7.2:1 on `surface` (light), 9.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet green ground: selected rows, selected filter chips, the Home path tiles. `ink` and `green-text` read on it.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet gold ground for a single 'new since last version' highlight. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: The white square the logo sits on in dark mode (the logo file has a white background). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: orange-ember
tokens.usage: Fire-orange option A: the reddest, closest to embers. `on-accent` reads on it at 4.8:1; 3.5:1 as a mark on `surface`.

tokens.name: orange-ember-pressed
tokens.usage: Option A pressed fill. `on-accent` still 4.5:1+.

tokens.name: orange-flame
tokens.usage: Fire-orange option B (recommended): a true flame orange. `on-accent` reads on it at 5.2:1; 3.2:1 as a mark on `surface`, 5.1:1 on dark `surface`.

tokens.name: orange-flame-pressed
tokens.usage: Option B pressed fill. `on-accent` 4.7:1.

tokens.name: orange-blaze
tokens.usage: Fire-orange option C: amber, toward the logo's gold. `on-accent` 5.5:1; 3.1:1 as a mark on `surface`.

tokens.name: orange-blaze-pressed
tokens.usage: Option C pressed fill. `on-accent` 4.9:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE orange in use. Points at the chosen option; change this one alias (and `accent-pressed`) to switch to Ember or Blaze. Capture button fill, the 4px active-tab bar, the current-step marker, small highlights. Never text, never a large background.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of the capture button. Follows `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-pressed`, both themes. Never white on orange (white fails at 3.4:1).

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Dark text on fixed mid-tone fills that stay the same in both themes: pupil tiles, `school-green`, `school-gold`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: A soft orange wash behind a just-saved confirmation or a single highlighted search hit. `ink` reads on it (14.4:1 / 12.7:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the statement card, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the expanded steps area, search field background, disabled control fill, the offline banner.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: inputs, segmented controls, unselected chips (3.6:1+ on every surface, both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, statement text, headings, on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and every tint (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: 'Why this matters' label, dates, counts, captions. 6.5:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast; always paired with a disabled cursor/state).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus outline with 2px offset, on every surface (16:1 light; gold 9.9:1+ dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus outline on `green-deep` and `pfa-deep` bars (gold, 4.4:1 on the light-theme bar).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: ladder
tokens.usage: Teal: a LADDER strand (taught in a set order). Badge text, the ladder icon, the 4px strand rule on map rows. 6.3:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ladder-tint
tokens.usage: Teal ground of the ladder badge. `ladder` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: exposure
tokens.usage: Sand: a REPEATED-EXPOSURE strand (met again and again). Darkened from sand so it reads as text (6.4:1).

tokens.name: exposure-tint
tokens.usage: Sand ground of the exposure badge. `exposure` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: pfa
tokens.usage: Plum: the PFA section only (Preparation for Adulthood). PFA headings, the PFA mode marker. Never appears in the main curriculum view.

tokens.name: pfa-tint
tokens.usage: Plum ground for PFA cards and the selected PFA segment. `pfa` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: pfa-deep
tokens.usage: The app bar in PFA mode, replacing `green-deep`, so the mode change is unmistakable. Text: `on-pfa-deep`.

tokens.name: on-pfa-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `pfa-deep` (9.9:1 / 11.1:1).

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Soft grey: small notes and gaps. Note text, the 'gap' label in a map cell. 5.9:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: note-tint
tokens.usage: Soft grey ground for an empty map cell (a gap) and inline notes.

tokens.name: eds-emerging
tokens.usage: Assessment step 1, Emerging: the lightest of one slate-blue hue. Selected fill of the E segment. Text: `ink`. Always with the word and the one-bar glyph.

tokens.name: eds-developing
tokens.usage: Assessment step 2, Developing: the middle step. Text: `ink` (8.7:1 light; 6.4:1 dark). Two-bar glyph.

tokens.name: eds-secure
tokens.usage: Assessment step 3, Secure: the strongest step. Text: `on-eds-secure`. Three-bar glyph. Not green, not traffic lights: Emerging is not a failure.

tokens.name: on-eds-secure
tokens.usage: Text on `eds-secure` (7.2:1 / 10.3:1).

tokens.name: pupil-1
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 1 (school green). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: pupil-2
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 2 (school gold). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: pupil-3
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 3 (light teal). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: pupil-4
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 4 (light plum). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: pupil-5
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 5 (light slate). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: pupil-6
tokens.usage: Pupil tile 6 (light sand). Pupil chips take tiles 1–6 in turn from the pseudonym. Text: `on-fill` (6.3:1+), same in both themes. Never orange.

tokens.name: print-frame-outer
tokens.usage: Outer line of the A4 page border (double frame). Print only; same in both themes.

tokens.name: print-frame-inner
tokens.usage: Inner line of the A4 page border. Print only.

tokens.name: print-ink
tokens.usage: All text on printed A4 pages (print is always light).

tokens.name: print-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows on printed pages and the photo edge. Print only.

tokens.name: print-paper
tokens.usage: Printed page ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The two Home paths and the evidence record's title. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section and phase headings inside a screen.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, enquiry titles, sheet headings.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: I can count a set of objects by grouping them in twos, fives and tens.
styles.usage: The 'I can…' statement: the main text of a statement card. Never reworded, never truncated.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Why this matters: grouping is the first step to multiplying, and it makes big counts faster and safer.
styles.usage: Default reading text, 'Why this matters', steps and probing questions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Two pupils · last record 3 days ago
styles.usage: The smallest reading size on iPad: secondary lines, list metadata.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Small labels above content (no uppercase: harder to read for dyslexic readers).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates and counts beside a larger element; never for a sentence.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The bettws_id, small at the end of a statement line. Never a heading or a name.

styles.name: print-statement
styles.sample: I can share a set equally between two people.
styles.usage: Ticked statements on the A4 record (about 11pt).

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Note: used a muffin tin to share 12 conkers.
styles.usage: Notes and labels on A4 pages (about 11pt).

styles.name: print-code
styles.usage: Codes at the end of a printed statement line (about 9pt).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inside a code tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; logo plate padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a statement and its code line; inside a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on iPad portrait; the side gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on landscape and desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a phase heading (it starts a new group).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of Home; around empty states.

radius.note: Square corners everywhere. There is one radius and it is 0.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every corner in the system: cards, buttons, chips, inputs, images, panels, pupil tiles, the A4 border. Set explicitly; never leave to browser defaults (iOS Safari rounds inputs and buttons unless told not to).

shadow.note: Elevation is quiet: hairline borders do most of the work.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat: list rows, map cells, anything inside a card.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on `surface` (statement, evidence, enquiry cards).

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: The capture sheet, dialogs, the sticky capture button over scrolling content.

size.note: Hands are busy: nothing tappable is smaller than size-touch.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable: chips, tabs, segments, list rows, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-touch-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, search field, the Main/PFA switch, E/D/S segments.

tokens.name: size-hero
tokens.usage: The capture button's height.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: size-pupil
tokens.usage: Pupil tile (square) beside a name; 32px variant inside evidence cards uses size-pupil-sm.

tokens.name: size-pupil-sm
tokens.usage: Pupil tile inside evidence cards and records.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on desktop; wider screens centre it.

border.note: Widths for lines and marks; colours come from `line`, `line-strong`, `accent`.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Card edges and row dividers (`line`).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, chips, segments (`line-strong`); selected outlines (`green-text`).

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: The orange bar under the active tab and beside the current capture step (`accent`).

tokens.name: border-strand
tokens.usage: The teal or sand rule at the start of a strand row in the curriculum map.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width (`focus-ring`).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus outline.

print.note: Every printed A4 page carries the same double frame: an outer school-green line, a gap, an inner school-gold line, square corners.

tokens.name: print-page-margin
tokens.usage: Paper edge to the outer frame line (inside printers' unprintable margin).

tokens.name: print-frame-outer-width
tokens.usage: Outer line of the page frame, in `print-frame-outer` (school green).

tokens.name: print-frame-gap
tokens.usage: White gap between the two frame lines.

tokens.name: print-frame-inner-width
tokens.usage: Inner line of the page frame, in `print-frame-inner` (school gold).

tokens.name: print-frame-padding
tokens.usage: Inner frame line to the page content.
